title: CV
summary: Frontend developer with four years of commercial work on Vue 3, TypeScript and Nuxt. I build design systems, speed up SSR and SPA apps, and shape data layers on TanStack Query and WebSocket. In my free time I make open source about sound.

bullets: Audiogram: a desktop player on Tauri 2, Vue 3 and TypeScript, 400+ commits and public releases.
lyra-audio: a browser audio library on the Web Audio API with an equaliser and HLS, published on npm.
TypeMore: a multiplayer typing trainer on Vue 3 and WebSocket with ratings and anti-cheat.
Designed and shipped a 25-component UI library on Vue 3, Nuxt and TypeScript that the company's internal products are built on.
Cut LCP from 2.5 to 1.2 seconds and raised Lighthouse by 30 points: code splitting, lazy loading, caching.
Built the data layer on TanStack Query with targeted caching and optimistic updates.
Optimised an SSR app for SEO and added RU/EN localisation.
Built filtering and search over tables of 1000+ rows with virtual scrolling.
Onboarded three developers and helped set up code review in a team of five.
Designed a UI component system from scratch on Vue 3, TypeScript and shadcn with light and dark themes.
Built responsive, pixel-perfect layouts for six key pages from Figma.
Improved FCP, LCP and TTI by about 40% in Lighthouse through rendering and asset loading work.
Shipped a PWA with an offline mode on Service Workers.
Agreed API contracts with the Java and Spring backend over OpenAPI and typed the data in TypeScript.
